name: Bellheim
notes:
A hard-to-find town in the Meridenour region of Koltan where the Rainbow Group formed. Evadne promised Benny she would visit someday and play Rockfinger's lute there once in his memory.

Benny's directions: "Be who you are."

name: Dawn Order Camp
notes:
Camp of the Dawn Order knights (the Ravens) in the Whispering Wood: Knight Commander Rain and Marcus the Strong.

The night of Duarte's moon lantern ceremony. Watches and stories were shared, and Uther vanished before morning, presumably heading for Nixthara.

name: Dravenspire
notes:
Uther planned to charter a skyship here before heading on to Nixthara.

Windrel saw a raven flying north toward Dravenspire. It stirred an unexplained memory and worry about Ashok.

name: Orville's Floating Tower
notes:
The party's base. Four hours west of the Dawn Order camp. Archmage Orville Thorne was an Aethrin, and Varmix the pseudodragon now keeps house.

Exits:
• the invisible staircase (no password)
• the face-guarded door to the Rookery's Vault of Requisitions in Galdoria (password: gazpacho)
• Charles's portal to New Verdan

The sentient pen (Sins) was found here, along with the Amulet of Kasaris and a lot of loot.

name: Galdoria
notes:
Coastal city in Aurion and home of the Rookery. Orville despised the Rookery, and it may be powered by a demon living beneath its tower. The tower's gazpacho door leads to the Rookery's Vault of Requisitions here.

The orc horde was last seen marching toward Galdoria.

Errand: deliver Marcus's satchel to Penelope at the Sanguine Reliquary in the slums.

name: New Verdan
notes: Reachable through the tower portal guarded by the spirit Charles. Orville had contacts here among the great council of seven.

name: Shadowfen Keep
notes:
An ancient, dilapidated keep from the War of Shadows, near the edge of Old Verdantia and the Whispering Wood. You enter through a cave with a glowing green archway, and a ley line river runs through it. The Battle of Shadowfen Keep was also fought here during the First Korithic War.

The party freed the Wynvale prisoners and hid them nearby. Vrae charged the Stone in the river and lost 16 max HP for it. Marquis Harold Hale Von Corvus threw himself into the ley line, and the drow inquisitor escaped with the second Stone.

Still unexplored: the door by the river, the north pit and stone door, and the green archway.

The party is here now.

name: Silver Petal Hall, Wynvale
notes:
Where it all began (the session notes spell the city Windvale). The party was inspecting three ancient artifacts, including the Stone of Gog, when an explosion destroyed the display case and the artifacts fell into a crater leading to the Underdark. At the same moment, orcs and masked men attacked the city. The orc army's insignia is a dagger through a snake. Survivors were taken to Shadowfen Keep.

Book joined the party here. The merchant Finkel Beans is also from Wynvale.

name: The Underdark Descent
notes:
Old Shadow Wars battlefield beneath the crater. Here the party:
• fought the boneless undead
• drove off the Oculi, a mass of ~50 floating eyes
• found the ritual chamber with the black portal ("the quickest way is through")
• freed and questioned the drow Uther Kirocathis (Golgothrak, Mantis Beatrix, Morithol)
• lost a commoner and a noble to the Vorlith on the collapsing bridge
• escaped past an ancient black dragon, possibly undead

name: Vedantian Relic Clearing
notes:
A glowing clearing with waterfalls along the Silverstream River. It holds an ancient circular sigil, one of the arcane batteries that kept cities aloft before the Great Fall. Nobody knows whether it still works.

Vrae and Windrel met Benny Rambato and Tongsa of the Rainbow Group here.
